purpose: First protected single-carrier sample-support, version/route/domain, time/geography and fixed-item coverage audit; discrepancy ledger, not sample correction.

carrier.identity_qualification: Inherited preserved regular CODED identity, not the NoPII-labelled clone; no participant contents or fresh carrier bytes inspected in this package.

projection.qualification: Field names are documentary proposals, not permission to read them. Recorded schema support is not a current dataset-schema check.

checks: fresh carrier byte/schema continuity under a later grant
unchanged historical cohort size and order through the diagnostic
internal KEY completeness and uniqueness without values in output
operations.limits: No name/phone matching, unique-person/household certification, new eligibility exclusion, reinstatement or raw490 replay.

checks: actual submitted-version dictionary and designed routes
literal allowlisted encoded multiselect parent/dummy concordance
accepted standalone provider routes and principal-account context
operations.limits: Unavailable option is not zero; response discrepancies remain reportable, not repaired. No free text or score construction.
Single carrier only: no fresh raw/audit timestamp comparison, inferred timezone cause, normalization, latest-return tenure, locality imputation or pooling.

checks: common valid/applicable coverage sets without calculating scores
operations.limits: No generated academic scores/categories, normalization, fitted e(sample), model, margins, prediction, posterior or retained row-level audit flags.

geography_rules: q3 code4 means Other in the first two forms and Soacha later
q3 code5 Meta exists only in2602120658
No Meta-to-Bogota pooling or Villavicencio inference
Do not treat overlay/regression groups as raw residence geography

output_allowlist.name: carrier_and_membership_checks.csv
output_allowlist.content: aggregate check IDs expected/observed counts and discrepancy status

output_allowlist.name: version_route_domain_states.csv
output_allowlist.content: item/version/state aggregate counts; restricted including small cells

output_allowlist.name: time_geography_lineage.csv
output_allowlist.content: field/version lineage and aggregate discrepancies; no individual dates/locations

output_allowlist.name: restricted_execution_receipts_and_log
output_allowlist.content: owned runtime/selection/stop/cleanup evidence without row values

output_restrictions: All outputs restricted; no public release follows from this package.
No KEY values, names, phones, administrative IDs, free text, coordinates, individual dates, participant lists or classifications.
No participant data export, saved modified dataset or retained row-level audit flags.
Public synopsis requires separate derivative-specific disclosure review.

proposed_limits_not_adopted.scope: Resource proposal only. Exact runtime/stop deadlines and feasibility must be adopted and tested before execution; no latent fit/retry budget.

remaining_bindings: owner accepts exact protected-use participant projection and restricted outputs
relevant rights/use conditions explicitly addressed without invented institutional clearance
current restricted absolute path and fresh opaque-byte/hash/schema check authorized
final field/output list and collision-free packet destination with retention conditions
owned runtime/build/interface identity and sufficient read capacity
scope-specific numeric budgets and independently usable stop/cleanup path verified under separate authority
final no-retry treatment and evidence receipts adopted
technical_stop_rules: unknown submitted form version or missing required static dictionary
unallowlisted field/output or unexpected participant-bearing export
request for correction, new score, fit, row-level output or extra input
substantive_discrepancy_rule: Known-domain contradictions, missing required answers and indeterminate eligibility support are valid audit findings. Record them within scope; do not demand all rows pass or automatically fix/drop cases. Stop only if evidence/authority cannot support the declared interpretation.
scope_specific_gate_rule: Protected internal coverage work needs its own rights/input/output and no-fit operational evidence. Do not require fitted-model stripes or public-release G7 for this task; do not treat no-fit as participant-access authority.
implementation_style: Future Stata MCP only; direct explicit commented researcher-readable commands, essential asserts, no fallback input, retry/helper framework or scientific-file process-control machinery.
